spans.s:
रोचक (कः-का-कं)
a. Stomachic.
m.
Hunger; the plantain; an onion.

रोचन (नः-ना-नी-नं)
a. Splendid,
pleasing; stimulant.
m. A species
of the silk-cotton tree; onion; a
stomachic.
f. (नी) Yellow pigment;
fine woman; red lotus;
Teori;
red arsenic.
f. (ना) A crinum.

रोचनिका (का) 1.
f. A sort of crinum.

रोचमान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Illuminated,
splendid, pleasing.
m. Tuft of
hair on the neck of a horse.

रोचिष्णु (ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
a. Elegantly
dressed or ornamented, splendid.

रोच्य (च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
a. That should be
illuminated or enlightened.
